# Global Connect

> Helping young people discover what's possible — international opportunities, online sessions, and practical guides.

## What this site offers

- **Opportunities** — International exchanges, scholarships, conferences and volunteering for young people
- **Online Sessions** — Speaking clubs, workshops and skill-building sessions
- **Guides** — How-to articles on applications, CVs, motivation letters, scholarships and more
- **Community** — A space for young people to connect and support each other

## Key pages

- /opportunities — Browse and filter opportunities by country, type, age, and funding
- /sessions — Explore upcoming online sessions
- /guides — Read practical guides on international programmes
- /about — Learn about Global Connect

## Contact

Reach out at hello@globalconnect.example
